reliability.title: Detection reliability
reliability.explain: The index is the probability that another sensor confirms the detection (0 to 1), based on its confidence, its persistence and its FRP. It measures whether the detection is seen again, not whether it is a real wildfire. Moderate discrimination (AUC 0.66 MODIS · 0.73 VIIRS). Each year weighs by its detections. Not comparable across sensors: each was calibrated against a different target (MODIS confirmed by VIIRS, which happens 93% of the time; VIIRS confirmed by NOAA-20, 66%), so a higher index for MODIS doesn't make it more reliable.

series.title: Continuous MODIS + VIIRS series
series.explain: Months without downloaded data are left blank (they are not zero). Before February 2012, MODIS (without bow-tie duplicates); after, VIIRS S-NPP ÷ k, in MODIS units. {k}. The monthly value is noisy: go by the 12-month mean.
